content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fargo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review your education and work history against these criteria. Fargo's Healthcare, Technology, Manufacturing, and Financial Services sectors all employ PMP-certified professionals—confirm you meet baseline requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions from your Fargo location on a schedule that fits your job and life. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full 35 contact hours PMI mandates, preparing you for exam content and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your PMP credential application, including proof of your education and project-management experience. Pay the associated examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify eligibility questions; PMI processes and approves your application before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and final-review sessions—to reinforce course material. Schedule your computerized exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. The PMP® exam tests your knowledge of project-management domains, frameworks, and situational judgment across 180 questions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification is valid for three years. Renew by earning 60 Professional Development Units (PDUs) during your certification cycle through approved training, volunteer work, or professional activities. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates to employers in Fargo's competitive job market that you remain skilled and engaged.
